notes.title: Update Notes For 26 Sept (2)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Change the daily puzzle reset time to 0:00 (GMT+0) every day. I believe this is more reasonable for a daily puzzle. This change will make today's puzzle (26 Sept) display for 1.5 days. Apologies for any inconvenience caused.
[*] Display the reset time countdown on the 'Today's Star' board.
[*] Add a UI to show the details of the daily puzzle.
[*] 'Today's Star' will display all entries in random order.
[*] Fix the bug with the 'Today's Star' display.
[*] Fix the bug that allows players to switch levels during the daily level.
[/list]
